page.layout: One page of verse in the main column; notes in the right margin beside the lines. Running head "GRÆCIA." at top, page number 123 at top right.

p.i: Dura manus: Deus ipso viros in puluere crudo
Arcas alit, nudaq; modo virtutis, & iras
Ingenerat: vigor inde animis, & mortis honora
Dulce sacrum, gaudent natorum in fata parentes,
Hortantúrque mori. deflet iámque omnis ephebum
Turba, coronato contenta est funere mater.
Frena tenent, duplexque inserto missile nodo
Exerti ingentes humeros: chlamys horrida pendet,
Et cono ledæus apex: non hi tibi solum
Elis, deprefsa populus subit incola Pisa.
Qui te flaue natant terris Alphæe Sicanis
Aduena tam longo non unquam infecte profundo.
Curribus innumeris late patria arua lacessunt,
Et bellis armenta domant, ea gloria genti
Infando de more, & fractis durat ab vsque
Vincula, & effossas niueus rigat imber arenas.

p.note: Chiron magister Achillis in monte Pelio habitauit.

page.notes: Marginal notes were partly unreadable at the right edge; the note at "Armatur" and "Echidnæ inc." may be cut short. Some line-ends are faint; readings are best effort.
